meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 具备 Telegram 频道能力:自动安装并注册适配器、构建验证,再引导你创建机器人、完成配对,之后即可通过 Telegram 对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加或配置 Telegram 机器人/频道时触发,技能会接管安装流程并引导完成配对。

say.text: 帮我添加 Telegram 机器人集成。
say.note: Claude 会开始安装适配器并询问机器人令牌。

say.text: 我要把 Telegram 频道接入 NanoClaw。
运行配对步骤,把当前聊天设为 Telegram 接收端。
say.note: Claude 会启动 4 位配对码验证。

howto.what_en: This skill gives Claude Telegram channel support: it installs and registers the adapter, validates the build, then guides you through bot creation and pairing so you can chat via Telegram.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to add or configure a Telegram bot/channel; it takes over the setup flow and walks you through pairing.

say_en.text: Add Telegram bot integration for me.
say_en.note: Claude starts installing the adapter and asks for the token.

say_en.text: I want to hook up a Telegram channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude registers the adapter, builds, and asks about BotFather.

say_en.text: Run the pairing step to set this chat as the Telegram receiver.
